import { Claim } from '../domain/claim/Claim';
import { ClaimRepository } from '../domain/claim/ClaimRepository';

export class InMemoryClaimRepository implements ClaimRepository {
  private readonly claims = new Map<string, Claim>();

  async byId(id: string): Promise<Claim | undefined> {
    return this.claims.get(id);
  }

  async save(claim: Claim): Promise<void> {
    this.claims.set(claim.id, claim);
  }
}

import { PaymentPort } from '../../../application/ports/out/PaymentPort';

export class CardPaymentAdapter implements PaymentPort {
  private readonly authorised = new Map<string, number>();

  async authorise(reference: string, amountCents: number): Promise<boolean> {
    if (amountCents <= 0) return false;
    this.authorised.set(reference, amountCents);
    return true;
  }

  async refund(reference: string): Promise<void> {
    this.authorised.delete(reference);
  }
}

import { SubscriptionError } from '../../domain/errors/SubscriptionError';
import { SubscriptionRepository } from '../../domain/ports/SubscriptionRepository';

export class CancelSubscription {
  constructor(private readonly subscriptions: SubscriptionRepository) {}

  async execute(subscriptionId: string, reason: string): Promise<{ id: string; reason: string }> {
    const subscription = await this.subscriptions.byId(subscriptionId);
    if (subscription === undefined) throw new SubscriptionError('not-found', `Unknown subscription ${subscriptionId}`);
    subscription.cancel();
    await this.subscriptions.save(subscription);
    return { id: subscription.id, reason: reason.trim() };
  }
}

=====SOURCE-END=====

import { PaymentPort } from '../../../application/ports/out/PaymentPort';
import { Spot } from '../../../domain/model/Spot';

export class CardPaymentAdapter implements PaymentPort {
  private readonly held = new Spot('u5a', 0, false, 0);
  private readonly authorised = new Map<string, number>();

  async authorise(reference: string, amountCents: number): Promise<boolean> {
    if (amountCents <= 0) return false;
    this.authorised.set(reference, amountCents);
    return true;
  }

  async refund(reference: string): Promise<void> {
    this.authorised.delete(reference);
  }
}
